mutations.name: Nonzero child termination is ignored
mutations.anchor: if (result.error || result.signal || result.status !== 0) fail('abnormal child termination; counts cannot override exit/signal/error');
mutations.replacement: if (false) fail('abnormal child termination; counts cannot override exit/signal/error');

mutations.name: Unapproved skipped assertions are accepted
mutations.anchor:
if (row.type !== 'test' || !approved.has(key) || row.skip !== policyForPlatform.reason
        || skippedNames.has(key)) fail(`unapproved or duplicate platform skip: ${file}: ${row.name}`);
mutations.replacement: if (false) fail(`unapproved or duplicate platform skip: ${file}: ${row.name}`);

mutations.name: Duplicate summaries are accepted
mutations.anchor: if (summaries.length !== 1) fail('exactly one aggregate summary is required');
mutations.replacement: if (false) fail('exactly one aggregate summary is required');

mutations.name: Missing file receipts are accepted
mutations.anchor: if (measured.size !== wanted.size || FIELDS.some(k => totals[k] !== counts[k])) fail('file coverage or aggregate reconciliation failed');
mutations.replacement: if (false) fail('file coverage or aggregate reconciliation failed');

mutations.name: A named platform guard may disappear
mutations.anchor: for (const key of approved) if (!seenNames.has(key)) fail('a named machine-gated test disappeared');
mutations.replacement: for (const key of approved) if (false) fail('a named machine-gated test disappeared');

mutations.name: Spec-only changes are omitted from selection
A matching pass count hides approved skipped assertions
